title: SNAIL
bigQuestion: How does a snail stay safe?
paragraphs: A snail carries a hard shell that covers its soft body. When danger comes, strong muscles pull the snail inside the shell. The shell blocks sharp teeth and helps keep the snail wet. This protection lets the snail rest until the danger passes.
